$comment: Band catalog. min and max drive both the tile rescale and the legend ticks, so they cannot drift apart. palette resolves against palettes.json. derivedFrom means the band is computed at ingest, not read raw from the source.

bands.label: Total Precipitation
bands.$comment: Cumulative since initialization. Never display this directly, difference it into the hourly band.

bands.label: Vert. Velocity 500 hPa
bands.$comment: Negative is upward motion. Reduces with min.

bands.label: Vert. Velocity 700 hPa
bands.$comment: Negative is upward motion. Reduces with min.

derivedFrom.$comment: gdaldem slope -compute_edges -s 111120, the scale factor is required for a geographic DEM. This native grid is for display and for the per pixel CARI raster. Scoring uses slope_5km, which is a different number.

bands.label: Elevation, 5 km
bands.$comment: Scoring input, not a map layer. Reduced from the native DEM with a max reducer so a district's highest cell drives its terrain conditions, which is what the legacy models do.

bands.label: Slope, 5 km
bands.$comment: Scoring input, not a map layer. Derived FROM elevation_5km, never from the native DEM. Slope over a 5 km run is far gentler than over 30 m, and both boolean models test slope at 15 degrees, so deriving it natively would fire the slope condition across every mountain district. See .claude/memory/slope-is-computed-at-5km.md.

bands.$pmdComment: PMD forecast bands. These are temporal: catalogued per cycle and per lead, so a tile request carries creation_time and lead. They come from the PMD portal, the one authenticated source, and are all surface level. The pressure level bands above (relative_humidity_pl700, vertical_velocity_pl500, and the rest) are the CARI inputs and are NOT what these are; PMD does not serve them for this account. min and max are display ranges judged against the measured data, unit matches what the PMD legend declares.
bands.$scaleComment: The portal encodes tenths of the physical unit only in its Int16 rasters (the GRAPES, ECMWF-IFS and GDFS feeds): temperature and dew point in tenths of a degree, humidity in tenths of a percent, precipitation and precipitable water in tenths of a millimetre. Its Float32 rasters (PMD-WRF and ICON, and CAPE everywhere) are already physical. sourceScale is the tenths factor, but the ingest applies it only to an integer source, so a Float32 field passes through untouched. Either way the stored COG, the legend, the identify tool and the CARI inputs read physical units. CAPE carries no sourceScale at all.
bands.label: CAPE

bands.$pmdLevelComment: Second wave of PMD bands, added once the model endpoint was found to serve pressure levels. HOURTPE is precipitation over the single step, not cumulative, so it needs no differencing. The _pl700, _pl500 and _pl850 bands are the pressure level fields the CARI model actually wants: PMD serves RH at 700 and 500 and temperature at 850 through the level parameter, which the surface-only feed did not. Vertical velocity and wind at level are still absent, so CARI is closer but not complete.
bands.label: Precipitation Rate
bands.$rateComment: PMD HOURTPE is precipitation over one forecast step, and the step is 1 h for WRFPRS but 3 h (occasionally 9 h) for the global models, so the raw per-step totals are not comparable between models. The ingest divides each step by its own length in hours, so the stored value is a mm/hr rate: honest per model and directly averageable for the multi model ensemble. sourceScale 0.1 still applies first to the Int16 feeds, before the division.

bands.$gfsWindComment: GFS u and v wind components at 850 hPa, kept internal. They are not map layers; they exist so the wind-field endpoint can recover direction for the barb overlay, which needs the vectors, not just the wind_speed_pl850 magnitude. Ingested by scripts/ingest/ingest_gfs.py under model GFS.
bands.label: Wind U 850 hPa
CAR Index per pixel
bands.$comment: The CAR Index graded on every forecast cell rather than reduced to a district, written by app.services.raster_score_service on the WRFPRS grid. Class breaks come from cari.json; the 0..100 percentage is rendered through the 7 class colours. Not a source band: it has no ingest, it is generated on demand and catalogued against the WRFPRS cycle.

bands.label: Hotspot Mask
bands.$comment: Binary mask, 1 where all 13 hotspot conditions hold on a cell, self-masked so only the true pixels render. Generated on demand on the WRFPRS grid and catalogued against its cycle. Requires precipitation_type_sfc, which is not yet ingested, so generation returns NOT_CONFIGURED naming it until that source lands.

bands.label: Ensemble Precipitation
bands.$comment: The plain per-pixel mean of every model's precipitation rate (pmd_hourtpe, mm/hr) on the WRFPRS grid. Each source is warped onto the WRFPRS cells (bilinear, same origin and exact overlap) and averaged with equal weight; a cell averages whichever models cover it. GFS carries no precipitation and is not in the mean. Generated on demand and catalogued against the WRFPRS cycle, the same way as cari_raster.
